create.name: Isaac Osborne
create.bio:
Isaac Osborne has spent more than 28 years working hands-on with the human body. He is a Certified Advanced Rolfer who trained through the Guild for Structural Integration under Emmett Hutchins, and he opened his own practice in 1999. He is also a certified personal trainer and corrective-exercise specialist with the National Academy of Sports Medicine. A lifelong martial artist and surfer, he came to Daoist medical qigong looking for the inner side of the movement arts he had practised for decades. He found that it brought his clinical work and personal practice together.

He moved his practice from Hawai'i to Santa Barbara in 2009. Through Motion Unlimited he offers structural integration, posture work and corrective exercise, and now teaches qigong as well. He is especially interested in fascia, breath mechanics and posture, and he leads White Tiger's free live classes on fascia. He is writing a book on fluid pressure, breath and fascia as the principles that organise human structure.
